format_codes.deN: N-team double elimination, single bracket; games 2N-2 to 2N-1
format_codes.de6_reseeded: 6-team double elimination, reseeded each round (top remaining seed vs lowest)
format_codes.de8_divisions_crossover: 8-team single-bracket double elimination, division seeds cross over
format_codes.de8_two_brackets_final: two 4-team double-elimination brackets (6-7 games each), one-game final
format_codes.de8_two_brackets_campus_bo3_final: two 4-team double-elimination brackets on campus, best-of-three final series
format_codes.se_playin_then_de4: one single-elimination game (4v5), then 4-team double elimination
format_codes.se_playin4_then_de4: single-elimination round among seeds 3-6, then 4-team double elimination with seeds 1-2
format_codes.se_playin4_then_de6: single-elimination round among seeds 5-8, then 6-team double elimination with seeds 1-4
format_codes.se2rounds_then_de4: SE round 1 (5-8), SE round 2 (winners vs 3-4), then 4-team double elimination with seeds 1-2
format_codes.se16_byes: 16-team single elimination, seeds 1-4 double bye, 5-8 single bye; 15 games
format_codes.pool4x3_then_se4: 4 pools of 3 (round robin), pool winners to single-elimination semifinals and final; 15 games
format_codes.bo3_series_4: 4 teams, best-of-three semifinal and final series; 6-9 games

games_note: games_min/games_max follow from the format: each double-elimination bracket of n teams plays 2n-2 games, or 2n-1 when the if-necessary game is needed; best-of-three series play 2-3 games. games_played_2025 is counted from the Wikipedia schedule table (null where the page has no itemized schedule).

site_codes.single: one site for the whole event
site_codes.campus: games at more than one member campus

auto_bid_note: Every conference listed awarded its automatic bid to the tournament champion in 2025. None used the regular-season champion and none skipped the tournament. Exception in practice: ASUN declared co-champions and gave the bid to Stetson by conference policy. NCAA 2025 manual: 29 automatic qualifiers; conference champions had to be determined by 11:59 p.m. ET Sunday, May 25.
confidence: B: every row comes from English Wikipedia (secondary). Official confirmation was read only for NEC and Big East; most conference sites (Sidearm) answered robots.txt with 403 bot protection and were not fetched.

Big Ten.qualify: top 12 of 17 by conference winning percentage
Big Ten.description: Four pools of three (round robin, 3 games per pool; pools 1/8/12, 2/7/11, 3/6/10, 4/5/9). Pool winners advance to single-elimination semifinals and a one-game final. 10-run rule after 7 innings.
Big Ten.venue: Charles Schwab Field Omaha, Omaha, NE
Big Ten.notes: Pool tiebreak rules not given on the page. 15 games is fixed (12 pool + 2 semifinals + 1 final).

SEC.qualify: all 16 teams, seeded by conference record
SEC.description: Single elimination, all 16 teams. Seeds 1-4 get a double bye to the quarterfinals, seeds 5-8 a bye to the second round; seeds 9-16 play the first round. First year of this format.

ACC.description: Single elimination, all 16 teams. Seeds 1-4 get a bye into the quarterfinals, seeds 5-8 a bye into the second round. Replaced the 12-team pool-play format used since 2007.
ACC.venue: Durham Bulls Athletic Park, Durham, NC

Big 12.qualify: top 12 of 14 (UCF and Utah did not qualify)
Big 12.description: Single elimination, 12 teams; seeds 1-4 get a first-round bye (first round 5-12, quarterfinals, semifinals, final). Changed from double elimination in 2024.

Sun Belt.qualify: top 10 of 14 by conference winning percentage
Sun Belt.description: Bottom four seeds (7-10) play a single-elimination play-in round (7v10, 8v9). The remaining eight play two 4-team double-elimination brackets; bracket winners meet in a one-game final.
Sun Belt.notes: Game numbering on the page runs to 17 (2 play-in + 2 x 7 bracket incl. if-necessary + final).

MAAC.qualify: top 8 of 13 by conference winning percentage (head-to-head first tiebreaker)
MAAC.description: Seeds 5-8 play a single-elimination first round (5v8, 6v7). Winners join seeds 3-4 in round two; seeds 1-2 enter in round three. All rounds after the first are double elimination (6-team double elimination).
MAAC.notes: Expanded from 6 to 8 teams in 2025 (Merrimack and Sacred Heart joined). Wikipedia lede says May 20-24; the schedule table has the final on Sunday May 25.

CAA.description: Modified double elimination, 6 teams, used since 2012. Each round is reseeded so the top remaining seed plays the lowest remaining seed; seeds 1-2 enter in round two.
CAA.venue: CofC Baseball Stadium at Patriots Point, Mount Pleasant, SC (College of Charleston, seed 4)

Atlantic 10.description: Double elimination, 7 teams (format since 2014). The top seed gets a first-round bye; the other six play on day one.

ASUN.qualify: top 4 of each 6-team division (Graphite, Gold), 8 of 12
ASUN.description: Single 8-team double-elimination bracket; division seeds cross over in round one (e.g. Gold 1 v Graphite 4). Championship game plus if-necessary game. Same format since 2023.
ASUN.venue: Melching Field at Conrad Park, DeLand, FL (Stetson, Graphite No. 1)
ASUN.auto_bid: tournament (2025: co-champions; berth by conference policy)
ASUN.notes: FGCU beat Stetson 6-5 (6 innings, weather) in the first final game. The deciding game was cancelled and the two were declared co-champions. 'Per conference policy' Stetson received the NCAA berth (the ASUN statement on asunsports.org is behind bot protection, so the policy text was not read).

SWAC.qualify: top 8 of 12 by conference winning percentage
SWAC.description: Two 4-team double-elimination brackets (1/8/3/6 and 2/7/4/5); bracket winners play a single-game championship.

Southland.description: Two 4-team double-elimination brackets at the home fields of seeds 1 and 2. Bracket winners play a best-of-three championship series at the field of the highest remaining seed. Same format as 2022.
Southland.venue: Brackets: Southeastern Louisiana and UTRGV home fields; final series: Husky Field (Houston Christian)
Southland.notes: Houston Christian swept New Orleans 2-0 in the final series. Nicholls, Stephen F. Austin and Incarnate Word did not qualify.

MAC.qualify: top 6 of 11 by conference winning percentage
MAC.description: Double elimination, 6 teams; seeds 1-2 enter in round two.

NEC.qualify: top 4 of 11 by conference winning percentage
NEC.venue: Heritage Financial Park, Wappingers Falls, NY
NEC.notes: Stonehill (4th seed) was not NCAA-eligible in 2025 (NCAA manual Appendix B) but played in the tournament.

official_sources.confirms: CCSU won game seven and 'earned the league's automatic bid to the NCAA Tournament'

Big West.qualify: top 5 of 11 by conference winning percentage
Big West.description: Seeds 4 and 5 play a single-elimination game; the winner joins seeds 1-3 in a 4-team double-elimination bracket. First Big West postseason tournament since 1998.
Big West.venue: Goodwin Field, Fullerton, CA (Cal State Fullerton, seed 3)
Big West.notes: Wikipedia lede says May 21-24; the if-necessary final game was played Sunday May 25.

OVC.qualify: top 8 of 10 by conference winning percentage
OVC.description: Two single-elimination rounds, then a 4-team double elimination. Round 1: seeds 5-8 (8v5, 7v6). Round 2: winners vs seeds 4 and 3 (single elimination). Round 3+: the two survivors and seeds 1-2 play a 4-team double elimination.
OVC.notes: The Wikipedia prose says 'top 4 teams receiving byes to the double elimination rounds', but its schedule shows seeds 3 and 4 eliminated after one loss in round two. Format inferred from the schedule. Lindenwood (6th seed) was not NCAA-eligible in 2025. Game 11 (if necessary) is listed without a result on the page.

MVC.qualify: top 8 of 10 by conference winning percentage
MVC.description: Four lowest seeds (5-8) play a single-elimination play-in round (8v5, 7v6). Winners join seeds 1-4 in a 6-team double-elimination bracket.
MVC.venue: Duffy Bass Field, Normal, IL (Illinois State, seed 5)

CUSA.qualify: top 8 of 10 by conference winning percentage
CUSA.description: Two 4-team double-elimination brackets, then a single-game championship. Same as 2024.
CUSA.venue: Liberty Baseball Stadium, Lynchburg, VA (Liberty, seed 8)

The American.description: Two 4-team double-elimination brackets (1/8/4/5 and 2/7/3/6) leading to a single championship game.
The American.notes: The bracket table shows an empty second-game slot in each bracket final, an if-necessary game, so games_max counts it. The official bracket PDF (theamerican.org) is behind bot protection.

WAC.qualify: top 8 of 9 by conference winning percentage
WAC.description: Seeds 5-8 play a single-elimination first round (8v5, 7v6). Winners join seeds 3-4 in round two and seeds 1-2 in round three of a 6-team double elimination.
WAC.notes: Wikipedia lede says May 21-24; the schedule table starts Tuesday May 20.

Big South.qualify: top 6 of 9 by conference winning percentage
Big South.description: Double elimination, 6 teams; seeds 1-2 enter in round two. Expanded from 4 teams in 2024.
Big South.notes: Truist Point is the High Point Rockers' minor-league park; High Point (seed 2) is a member.

WCC.qualify: top 6 of 9 by conference winning percentage
WCC.description: Seeds 3-6 play a single-elimination first round (3v6, 4v5). The two winners join seeds 1-2 in a 4-team double elimination.
WCC.venue: Las Vegas Ballpark, Las Vegas, NV

Mountain West.qualify: top 6 of 8 by conference winning percentage
Mountain West.description: Seeds 3-6 play a single-elimination first round (3v6, 4v5). The two winners join seeds 1-2 in a 4-team double elimination.

SoCon.qualify: all 8 teams, seeded by conference record
SoCon.description: Bottom four seeds play a single-elimination play-in round. Winners join the top four in a 6-team double elimination: seeds 3-4 play the play-in winners in round two, seeds 1-2 get byes into round three.
SoCon.venue: Fluor Field at the West End, Greenville, SC
SoCon.notes: No standalone 2025 tournament article: '2025 Southern Conference baseball tournament' redirects to the season article's Tournament section, which is saved.

Big East.qualify: top 4 of 8 by conference winning percentage

official_sources.confirms: 'Creighton locks up the BIG EAST's automatic bid'; game list 1-6 with seeds matches 4-team double elimination

Ivy League.qualify: top 4 of 8 by league record (head-to-head tiebreak)
Ivy League.description: Double elimination, 4 teams, at the regular-season champion's site.
Ivy League.venue: George H. W. Bush Field, New Haven, CT (Yale)

America East.qualify: top 6 of 7 by conference winning percentage
America East.description: Seeds 3-6 play a single-elimination first round. The two winners join seeds 1-2 in a 4-team double elimination. Same format since 2023.
America East.notes: Wikipedia lede says May 21-24; the schedule table has the final games on Sunday May 25.

Patriot.description: Best-of-three semifinal series (1v4, 2v3) hosted by the higher seed, then a best-of-three final series hosted by the higher seed, on consecutive weekends. The higher seed is the home team for every game.
Patriot.venue: Higher seed's home field (final: Fitton Field, Worcester, MA, Holy Cross)
Patriot.notes: Semifinal series results are not itemized on the page. The final went Holy Cross over Army.

Horizon.description: Double elimination, all six teams; seeds 1-2 get a single bye.
Horizon.venue: Nischwitz Stadium, Fairborn, OH (Wright State, seed 1)
Horizon.notes: Wikipedia cites a Xenia Gazette article, 'Wright State set to host league tournament'. Whether hosting goes to the top seed or is predetermined is not stated.

Summit League.qualify: top 4 of the 5 eligible teams (St. Thomas ineligible until 2026)
Summit League.description: Double elimination, 4 teams, after a double round-robin regular season.
Summit League.venue: Tal Anderson Field, Omaha, NE (Omaha, seed 3)
Summit League.notes: St. Thomas (ineligible) and Northern Colorado did not take part. The official bracket news page returned 403 and the bracket PDF is disallowed by robots.txt.
